description: This file defines the 'Connection' class for the MySQLi driver in Drupal, implementing database connection handling, including connection setup, error handling, and transaction management.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Implements the Drupal database connection interface using MySQLi, handling connection initialization, error handling, and transaction management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Connection object, configuring identifier quotes based on SQL mode.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Establishes a new MySQLi connection with provided options, setting character set and executing initial commands.

methods.name: clientVersion
methods.description: Returns the MySQLi client version information.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database and sets it as the active database.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in SQL queries.

methods.name: lastInsertId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the last inserted row.

methods.name: driverTransactionManager
methods.description: Returns a new TransactionManager instance for handling transactions.
